announcement.title: 🎁 Unboxing the Mystery v1.5.0
announcement.content:
Unboxing the Mystery v1.5.0 adds Mystery Chains, Mystery Kit packages, and finite reward decks.

  • Connect existing puzzle modes into an ordered Mystery Chain, then supervise progress, hints, pauses, reassignment, and completion from the Mystery Director.
  • Assign a solver and viewers for directed reveals, or pause unresolved play without deleting settings or progress while unrevealed content stays sealed.
  • Export configured Journal pages or Items as Mystery Kit ZIP packages with selected linked documents, gacha pools, and user-data media. External dependencies remain external.
  • Run shared or per-player finite reward decks with stock management, scheduled refills, banner windows, and real-time or game-time clocks.
  • Convert duplicate rewards, import RollTable Items, hide pools from the default toolbar, preserve pool settings during transfer, and run Tile success or failure macros.
  • This release also fixes bonus pulls, legacy Journal targeting, Rune Matching and Circuit Maze spectator synchronization, MATT already-revealed routing, and empty Tile image field preservation.

GlitchSmith Library 0.13.0 or later is required.
